chars.DRIVER: a skinny young man in his early 20s wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, faded blue jeans and worn white sneakers
chars.DRIVERH: a skinny young man in his early 20s wearing ONLY old baggy red shorts with holes in them (bare chest, bare feet), a mustard-yellow hoodie hanging on a hook
chars.HAJJA: an elegant plump woman in her late 40s with an emerald-green silk headscarf wrapping her head, a long burgundy velvet Moroccan kaftan with gold embroidery, gold bracelets

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In the marble hallway of a huge luxurious villa in Rabat, the soaked, muddy young driver dripping rainwater holds a ragged old beach towel full of holes, while the elegant lady of the house hands him a thick new fluffy white towel, raising her eyebrows; he looks embarrassed. Rain visible through a big window.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Inside a luxurious marble bathroom, the young driver holds up a black scrubbing mitt full of holes with his fingers poking through it, looking at it ashamed and comically awkward.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: The young driver kneels and pulls things from a crumpled plastic bag onto a shiny marble floor: an old tin box of brown traditional black soap and an almost empty, battered shampoo bottle, next to golden luxury fittings. Funny contrast.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Close shot: the young driver squeezes an almost empty battered shampoo bottle over his palm, only one small drop comes out, he grimaces, gold taps and marble around him.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: The young driver stands open-mouthed with amazement at the entrance of a huge private Moroccan hammam in a villa: white marble, steam, a mosaic dome, a wooden sauna door with a small glass window.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: In the steamy private marble hammam the young driver sits on the floor scrubbing his arm with the holey mitt, then freezes in panic, staring at the closed wooden door as if someone is knocking on it, eyes wide.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: The lady of the house has opened the hammam door and stands in the doorway in steam, staring with surprise and pity at the torn black scrubbing mitt the young driver is holding; he sits on the marble floor frozen, hugging his knees in shock.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Comic scene in the steamy marble hammam: the lady of the house rolls up her kaftan sleeves holding a brand-new scrubbing mitt with a determined smile, stepping toward him; the young driver backs away against the wall, shocked, hands raised.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: The young driver sits in the steamy hammam wearing only his old red shorts full of holes, covering the holes with both hands, sweating and mortified, comic awkward face.
